Tom: Can we do a blind draw? pick a sticker envelope and take the snack inside. :grin:

StickerBot: Reminder: all food items must be sealed. Non-perishable only. See office policy link: https://intranet/office/holiday-guidelines
Rae: Great. Drop-off window: Thursday 9am-5pm. I'll label a box "Sticker Roulette - Fri Table"
Ben: Quick poll: paper notes okay or stick to stickers only? react :white_check_mark: paper ok, :x: stickers only
Ivy: :white_check_mark:
Tom: :white_check_mark:
Annie: I'll bring envelopes and some twine to make it festive.
Rae: OK final note — PG photos only when you post winners. Can't wait :sparkles:
